ns2:section.sectionText: This summer online course includes weekly online lectures and discussions, readings, self-directed field trips, videos, and hands-on art making/studio activities to provide insight to a wide range of artistic practice. This online version of the course provides an introduction to art through thematic lectures exploring both historical and contemporary artistic practices with a self-directed creative and expressive exploration of multiple art media. Studio techniques will be taught through online video tutorials and documentation of studio explorations and projects will be submitted through compass.
